Rules: (list)

2) Blue people are round.
3) All young people are nice.
4) All young people are quiet.
5) All smart people are not quiet. (i.e., smart -> not quiet)
6) If someone is kind and not young then they are quiet.
7) Young, quiet people are not blue. (i.e., if someone is young and quiet then they are not blue)
8) If someone is round then they are smart.

Goal: Bob is smart.

Given: Bob is blue.

From rule 2: Blue people are round => Bob is round.

From rule 8: If someone is round then they are smart => Bob is smart.

Thus Bob is smart follows.

But we must ensure no contradictions that might block. Let's check if any other facts cause contradictions: Bob is blue, Bob is round (from rule 2). Bob is round => Bob is smart (rule 8). No contradictions.

Check other facts: Erin is not round; irrelevant.

Check rule 1: If someone is nice and not young then they are round. Not needed.

Rule 3: All young people are nice. Not needed.

Rule 4: All young people are quiet. Not needed.

Rule 5: All smart people are not quiet. So if Bob is smart then Bob is not quiet. No conflict.

Rule 6: If someone is kind and not young then they are quiet. Not needed.

Rule 7: Young, quiet people are not blue. Not relevant.

Thus answer: True.
